patterns_to_copy: AC is table stakes: 5 of 6 top comps explicitly include AC (and Peter says 'fully air-conditioned' with AC in every bedroom). None charge coin-op/extra for AC. (Portia is the only AC-omitting one and still hits 5.0 - but she's the exception, not the model.)

Self check-in is the norm: 4 of 6 (Peter, Alison, Magdalena, Marijana) offer lockbox/self check-in. The two without it (Patricia in-person window) still note a clear coordinated check-in. Stephanie's 3 listings show NO self check-in.

Lead the description with the single biggest USP, not the floor plan: Alison opens with 'pool + direct sea views'; Patricia with 'high-end 360 views'; Portia with bay/garden view + premium tech. They sell the hook in line 1.
Photo volume + professional quality: top presenters run 24-61 photos (Portia 61, Peter 33, Magdalena 24); pro/staged, view/pool shown early. Average ~30+ across the captured set.
Superhost: ALL 6 top comps are Superhost. Stephanie is Superhost on NONE.

Family/comfort signals win 5.0s: Marijana (crib+high chair+kids books) and Magdalena (washer+dryer) lean into completeness; Peter's exhaustive 'what we provide' checklist sets expectations and drives 5.0 accuracy.
No cleaning fee is universal here (all-in nightly pricing) - a shared market norm, not a differentiator.
gaps_vs_stephanie: NOT Superhost on any of 3 listings vs all 6 comps Superhost - the single clearest trust gap.
No self check-in shown on any of Stephanie's 3 (comps mostly self check-in) - friction + perceived lower convenience.
Generic/feature-flat titles ('Apartment with sea views', 'Apartment with an exceptional view') vs comps leading with a sharp USP.
Lower headline ratings (4.79 / 4.8 / no-reviews) vs comps' 4.95-5.0.
AC: Stephanie DOES include AC (split ductless on all 3) - so this is NOT a gap; she should advertise it more prominently as comps do.
